name: gitlab-mcp
description: GitLab over MCP from your own account: issues, merge requests, reviews, the repository and CI.
long_description:
Work inside GitLab projects from your own account, on gitlab.com or a self-managed instance: find and read issues and merge requests, review a merge request, read the repository and CI. Content from GitLab is marked as untrusted data rather than instructions. Nothing this server writes runs a quick action, code reaches a protected branch only through a merge request, and merging, approving, running CI and deleting are not offered unless you turn them on.

THIS BUNDLE DOES NOT LOG YOU IN, and cannot. Each person brings their own OAuth application, so before the tools work you need to register one on your GitLab instance and run `gitlab-mcp login --client-id <application id>` once from a terminal (add `--instance <url>` for a self-managed instance). The setup is documented at https://github.com/mmedum/gitlab-mcp/blob/main/docs/setup.md. Without that step the server starts, lists its tools, and answers every call with "not signed in".

instance.title: GitLab instance
instance.description: The instance's base URL. https://gitlab.com, or your self-managed instance.

client_id.title: OAuth application id
client_id.description: The id of the OAuth application you registered on that instance. You still need to run `gitlab-mcp login --client-id <application id>` once from a terminal.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Which stored login to use. Separate profiles keep separate tokens, such as one for gitlab.com and one for a self-managed instance.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Register only the read tools and use a read_api token, so GitLab itself refuses a write. Needs a login made in read-only mode.
